title: Commas with FANBOYS (for, and, nor, but, or, yet, so)

vocabulary.meaning_en: the punctuation mark (,) that shows a short pause, separates a list, or divides large numbers
vocabulary.example: Put a comma before "so" when it joins two sentences.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a sign like . , ? ! used in writing
vocabulary.example: A period is a punctuation mark.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the mark (.) at the end of a sentence (UK: full stop)
vocabulary.example: End the sentence with a period.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a word that joins words or ideas
one of the FANBOYS words that join two equal ideas
an acronym: For, And, Nor, But, Or, Yet, So
vocabulary.example: Remember the FANBOYS: for, and, nor, but, or, yet, so.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a word made from the first letters of other words
a person who loves a product, game or company very much
vocabulary.example: He's a fanboy; he buys every new phone from that company.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a group of words with a subject and a verb
vocabulary.example: "He bought a bicycle" is a clause.

vocabulary.meaning_en: part of a sentence, not a complete idea (a fat cat)
vocabulary.example: "A Superman comic" is a sentence fragment.
Two complete sentences joined by "and" are balanced.

vocabulary.meaning_en: something that happens because of something else
vocabulary.example: We were tired, so we went home. (result)

fine_lines.title: comma vs no comma before FANBOYS
fine_lines.explanation_ar: إذا ربطت أداة العطف جملتين كاملتين (فيهما فاعل وفعل) نضع فاصلة قبلها. إذا ربطت جملة كاملة بجزء جملة (اسم أو عبارة) فلا نضع فاصلة.
fine_lines.explanation_en: If a FANBOYS word joins two complete sentences (each with a subject and a verb), put a comma before it. If it joins a sentence and a fragment (a noun or phrase), no comma.

examples.sentence: Mr. E went to the store, and he bought a bicycle.
Mr. E likes to eat hamburgers and pizza.

fine_lines.title: but vs yet
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الاثنان للتناقض. yet تشبه but لكنها تحمل معنى المفاجأة: رغم ذلك.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Both show contrast. Yet is like but, with a feeling of surprise: even so.

examples.sentence: I like this shirt, but I don't want to buy it.
He studied very little, yet he passed the test.

fine_lines.title: and vs nor
fine_lines.explanation_ar: and تجمع فكرتين موجبتين. nor تجمع فكرتين منفيتين، وبعدها نقدّم الفعل المساعد: nor has he...
fine_lines.explanation_en: And joins two positive ideas. Nor joins two negative ideas; after nor the auxiliary comes first: nor has he...

examples.sentence: He loves ice cream, and he loves juice.
James has not been to Barcelona, nor has he lived in London.

expressions.example: Tia moved to a new city, so she got a new apartment.
We went inside, for it was raining.
You can stay here, or you can come with us.

expressions.meaning_en: the thing or person someone loves
expressions.example: Football is his object of affection.

grammar.title: Three basic uses of the comma
grammar.explanation_ar: (1) وقفة قصيرة بين أجزاء الجملة. (2) فصل عناصر القائمة (knives, forks, spoons). (3) في الأعداد الكبيرة: 1,000 و 1,000,000.
grammar.explanation_en: (1) A short pause between parts of a sentence. (2) Separating items in a list (knives, forks, spoons). (3) In large numbers: 1,000 and 1,000,000.
examples: When I got home, I ate.
I bought eggs, milk, bread and rice.

grammar.title: FANBOYS meanings
grammar.explanation_ar: For = سبب. And = إضافة. Nor = إضافة منفية. But = تناقض أو استثناء. Or = اختيار. Yet = تناقض (مثل but). So = نتيجة.
grammar.explanation_en: For = reason. And = addition. Nor = negative addition. But = contrast or exception. Or = choice. Yet = contrast (like but). So = result.
examples: We were tired, so we went home.
You can go, but your friend can't.

grammar.title: Rule: sentence + comma + FANBOYS + sentence
grammar.explanation_ar: عند ربط جملتين كاملتين متوازنتين: الجملة الأولى + فاصلة + أداة العطف + الجملة الثانية. الفاصلة تأتي قبل أداة العطف وليس بعدها. (مع and القصيرة قد تكون الفاصلة اختيارية.)
grammar.explanation_en: To join two balanced complete sentences: sentence 1 + comma + FANBOYS word + sentence 2. The comma goes before the conjunction, not after it. (With short and-sentences the comma is sometimes optional.)
examples: Alena likes ice cream, but it gives her a stomachache.
Mr. E went to the store, and he bought a bicycle.

grammar.title: No comma with a fragment
grammar.explanation_ar: إذا كان الجزء الثاني ليس جملة كاملة (لا فاعل وفعل) فلا نضع فاصلة.
grammar.explanation_en: If the second part is not a complete sentence (no subject + verb), don't use a comma.
examples: Mr. E is going to buy a Batman comic or a Superman comic.

questions.question: What does FANBOYS stand for?
choices: for, and, nor, but, or, yet, so
for, after, not, because, or, yes, so
from, and, no, but, of, yet, since
for, and, now, by, on, yet, so

questions.question: Where does the comma go?
choices: Tia moved to a new city so, she got an apartment.
Tia moved to a new city, so she got an apartment.
Tia moved, to a new city so she got an apartment.
Tia moved to a new city so she, got an apartment.
questions.explanation_en: The comma goes before the conjunction.

questions.question: Does this need a comma? "Mr. E likes hamburgers and pizza."
choices: No, "pizza" is not a complete sentence.
questions.explanation_en: The second part is not a complete sentence.

questions.question: "James has not been to Barcelona, ___ has he lived in London."
"He studied very little, ___ he passed the test." (surprising contrast)
Which is NOT a use of the comma in this lesson?
Two complete ideas joined by a conjunction are ___.
questions.explanation_en: Balanced, so we use a comma.
